note: The script asks for the hook text, Christie's name super and key words on four rows, so six graphics. The end card is NIWRC's own.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “YOU DON’T HEAR ABOUT IT.” Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Hook text over her face from frame 1. Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until the cut at 00:05.

mg.title: Christie name super

text.sub: Secretary, Iowa Tribe of Oklahoma · NIWRC Board

mg.title: Take it more seriously
mg.cue: Then key words: “take it more seriously”.
mg.use: Key words in the top third, after the name super. Put them on as she says “take it more seriously”.

mg.title: Safe house for women

mg.use: Key words in the top third. Put them on as she says “a safe house for our women”.

mg.use: Key words in the top third. Put them on as she says “advocacy and awareness” and hold through “on the Hill”.

mg.use: Key words in the top third. Put them on as she says “precious” and hold through “safe and loved”.
